criteria.run: The change touches user-facing screens, flows or copy, so a UX review has something to check

skip.what: The change has no user-facing surface, so a UX review would find nothing
skip.not_for: a change that might alter what this reviewer checks

instructions.question: Does the UX reviewer have anything to review in this round's change?
instructions.about: The files changed on a job branch in a software repo, and which of them are UI files.
instructions.judge_by: The UI files named in the ux line of the state. Skip only when nothing in the change could affect how a person uses the product.

criteria.run: The change touches markup, styles, components or other visual code, so a UI review has something to check

skip.what: The change has no visual code, so a UI review would find nothing
skip.not_for: a change that might alter what this reviewer checks

instructions.question: Does the UI reviewer have anything to review in this round's change?
instructions.about: The files changed on a job branch in a software repo, and which of them are UI files.
instructions.judge_by: The UI files named in the ui line of the state. Skip only when nothing in the change could affect what is rendered.

criteria.run: The change could affect authentication, secrets, input handling, permissions or dependencies, or the last review was not clean

skip.what: The last security review passed cleanly and the fixes since touched nothing security-relevant
skip.not_for: a change that might alter what this reviewer checks

instructions.question: Does the security reviewer have anything to review in this round's change?
instructions.about: The files changed on a job branch in a software repo, the security reviewer's previous verdict and the files its fix tasks changed.
instructions.judge_by: The security line of the state: the previous verdict, its counts and the files changed since. Skip only when the fixes cannot have introduced a security problem.

criteria.run: The change adds or alters logic, or the last review was not clean

skip.what: The last code review passed cleanly and the fixes since only touched text, comments or docs
skip.not_for: a change that might alter what this reviewer checks

instructions.question: Does the code reviewer have anything to review in this round's change?
instructions.about: The files changed on a job branch in a software repo, the code reviewer's previous verdict and the files its fix tasks changed.
instructions.judge_by: The code line of the state: the previous verdict, its counts and the files changed since. Skip only when the fixes cannot have introduced a defect.
